root.label: Parades Commission allows Drumcree march with restrictions

events.label: Parades Commission allows Drumcree march with restrictions

slots.name: ban year
slots.sentence: Northern Ireland's Parades Commission last month allowed the Orange Order to march along the Garvaghy Road, a Catholic area in the mainly Protestant town of Portadown, for the first time since parades on the route were banned in 1998.

events.label: Northern Ireland minister overturns Orange Order parade permit

slots.name: standoff duration
slots.sentence: Britain's Northern Ireland minister on Friday overturned a decision by local authorities that granted a permit for a Protestant parade to pass through a Catholic area and triggered a two-week standoff that raised tensions in the region.
